items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: Rex came in the day before? Rex come in the day before, on a Monday.

ctx.x: Rex came in the day before? Rex come in the day before, on a Monday. But now, in the later years when all these other Hormies and Babylon and all that come in the picture, they did away with it. In other words, they did away with that during World War II. World War II changed a lot of things, Mr. Russell. Just like the young men of liberty down there, they used music at every funeral. But when World War II broke out, after they asked not to have no crowds or nothing, assembly no crowds or nothing, that went out…
Did you ever play any Mardi Gras parades yourself? You mean the big parades?
